## What this fixes

**Hardest item on the list below (item #1):** `SafetyPolicySeam` existed as a complete SDD artifact — contract, mock, fixtures, and tests — but was never called from any pipeline or route. User-submitted coloring-page specs containing disallowed keywords (`minors`, `self-harm`, `suicide`, `extremist`) passed through unchecked all the way to xAI image generation.

This PR wires the seam in as the **first gate in the generate pipeline**, short-circuiting with `CONTENT_POLICY_VIOLATION` (HTTP 400) before any costly downstream seam (spec validation, prompt assembly, image generation) is called.

---

## Changes

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/lib/seams/safety-policy-seam/contract.ts` | Added `validateSpec(spec: ColoringPageSpec): SafetyPolicyResult` |
| `src/lib/seams/safety-policy-seam/mock.ts` | Implemented `validateSpec` — scans title, item labels, footer label, dedication |
| `src/lib/seams/safety-policy-seam/fixtures.ts` | Added `safeSpecFixture`, `unsafeSpecFixture`, `unsafeSpecItemFixture` |
| `src/lib/seams/safety-policy-seam/test.ts` | 3 new contract tests for `validateSpec` |
| `src/lib/core/generate-pipeline.ts` | Imported seam, added `checkContentSafety` dep, called before spec validation |
| `tests/unit/pipeline-edge-cases.test.ts` | Added `checkContentSafety` stub to `baseDeps` and all inline deps |
| `tests/unit/api-generate.test.ts` | Added `CONTENT_POLICY_VIOLATION` integration test |
| `DECISIONS.md` | Cipher Gate entry recorded |

---

## Top 10 most difficult upgrades / fixes in this repo

1. ~~**SafetyPolicySeam never wired into any pipeline** — Full SDD artifact (contract + mock + tests + fixtures) exists but `validateUserRequest` and `validateCompiledPrompt` were never called from any pipeline or route, meaning user prompts with disallowed keywords reached xAI unchecked. Required extending the contract with `validateSpec(ColoringPageSpec)`, threading dependency injection through `generate-pipeline.ts`, adding 3 fixture variants, 3 new seam tests, updating 2 pipeline test suites, and recording a Cipher Gate.~~

2. **TelemetrySeam is defined but never emits events** — The telemetry seam (`src/lib/seams/telemetry-seam/`) has a full contract, mock, and tests but `emit()` is never called from any pipeline or route. The app has zero observability data. Wiring it in requires threading it through all core pipelines as an injected dep.

3. **GalleryStoreSeam and PromptCompilerSeam have no real adapters** — Full SDD seam artifacts (contract, mock, test, fixtures) exist but neither `src/lib/adapters/gallery-store-seam/` nor `src/lib/adapters/prompt-compiler-seam/` exist. These features cannot function in production without implementing the full SDD adapter workflow.

4. **PromptCompilerSeam and GalleryStoreSeam mocks violate SDD: hardcoded logic instead of fixture scenarios** — Both mock files carry `// TODO: Refactor to load from fixture scenarios per SDD conventions` comments. The mocks compute output from inline logic rather than loading from fixture files, breaking SDD's determinism guarantee. Schema drift won't be caught by contract tests until a mock is updated by hand.

5. **WigTryOnSeam Gemini API call lacks retry/backoff** — `src/lib/adapters/wig-try-on-seam/index.ts` uses `fetchWithTimeout` but not `fetchWithRetry`. Rate-limit (429) and transient 5xx Gemini errors fail immediately with no retry, unlike `ProviderAdapterSeam` which uses both. The 120-second timeout means a bad request soaks a server thread before the error surfaces.

6. **WigTryOnSeam probe permanently blocked** — Marked `TBD (blocked)` in `docs/seams.md`: this critical external-I/O seam has never been probed against real Gemini API behavior. SDD's "Reality first" mandate is violated; the adapter's multi-image request format and Gemini's actual response shape are unverified by any live probe.

7. **Race condition in draft-save debounce** — `scheduleDraftSave()` in `src/routes/+page.svelte` uses a single `isDraftSavePending` boolean that can silently drop intermediate state mutations while a save is in flight. Rapid edits during an in-flight save lose all but the most recent queued change.

8. **`onMount` async initialization lacks error boundary** — `Promise.all([sessionAdapter.getSession(), creationStoreAdapter.getDraft({})])` in `+page.svelte` is not wrapped in `try/catch`. If either seam _throws_ (as opposed to returning `{ ok: false }`), the app renders blank with no error state shown to the user.

9. **CacheSeam probe is manual-only with no CI enforcement** — `docs/seams.md` records the CacheSeam probe as `2026-05-15 (manual)` (DevTools only). The PWA offline-caching contract has no automated CI validation; a broken service worker build would only be caught in production.

10. **Duplicate ImageGenerationSeam registry entries** — `docs/seams.md` lists `ImageGenerationSeam` twice — once for the flat layout (`contracts/image-generation.contract.ts`) and once for the self-contained layout (`src/lib/seams/image-generation-seam/contract.ts`). No decommission notice removes the flat-layout entry, creating ongoing ambiguity about which contract is authoritative and which tests matter.

---

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm test` — all existing tests pass; 3 new `SafetyPolicySeam` contract tests pass; 1 new `api-generate` integration test passes; `pipeline-edge-cases` tests pass with `checkContentSafety` stub in deps
- [ ] POST `/api/generate` with `title: "minors only"` returns HTTP 400 `CONTENT_POLICY_VIOLATION` before calling image generation
- [ ] POST `/api/generate` with clean spec proceeds normally through the pipeline

## Summary by Sourcery

Add a content-safety gate to the generate pipeline using SafetyPolicySeam and enforce it via contract, fixtures, and tests.

New Features:
- Introduce ColoringPageSpec-based content-safety validation in SafetyPolicySeam and expose it via the generate pipeline as a checkContentSafety dependency.

Bug Fixes:
- Prevent unsafe coloring-page specs containing disallowed keywords from reaching image generation by short-circuiting the pipeline with a CONTENT_POLICY_VIOLATION error.

Enhancements:
- Extend SafetyPolicySeam fixtures and contract tests to cover ColoringPageSpec validation scenarios.
- Document the SafetyPolicySeam wiring decision and rationale as a Cipher Gate entry in DECISIONS.md.

Tests:
- Add unit tests for SafetyPolicySeam.validateSpec and generate pipeline edge cases, plus an integration test ensuring /api/generate rejects unsafe specs before image generation.

reviews.body:
## Code Review

This pull request integrates the `SafetyPolicySeam` content-safety gate into the generation pipeline (`generate-pipeline.ts`) to scan coloring-page specs for disallowed keywords before downstream processing. While the overall implementation is solid and well-tested, there is a potential crash risk in the mock safety policy seam (`validateSpec` method) where direct property access on unvalidated spec fields could throw a `TypeError`. Utilizing optional chaining and filtering is recommended to ensure robustness.

Hey - I've found 1 issue, and left some high level feedback:

- In `createMockSafetyPolicySeam().validateSpec`, consider filtering out falsy `text` values before calling `hasDisallowedContent` so the helper never has to handle `undefined` or `null` inputs.
- `generate-pipeline.ts` currently imports the mock safety seam directly (`createMockSafetyPolicySeam`); it may be cleaner to route this through an adapter or a production-facing seam entrypoint so the core pipeline doesn’t depend on a mock implementation by name.
